profile.headline: Software Engineer at Clover
profile.geoLocationName: Berkeley Heights, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
Jeff Bezos said: “One of the only ways to get out of a tight box is to invent your way out”. We live in a time where technology is limitless and impacts us to improve and help us develop like never before. 

I am a passionate and zealous software developer who enjoys being on the leading edge of technology. I am proficient in Java, C#, MERN, and Python with Flask and Django.

My skills include:

Languages: Java, C#, Python, JavaScript (ES5, ES6), TypeScript, HTML, CSS
Front-end/Libraries: Mongoose, React, jQuery, Ajax, Bootstrap, Materialize, SocketIO
Frameworks: Angular4/5, Flask, Django, Node, Express, ASP.NET, Entity, Springboot, Karate
Dev Tools: AWS EC2, GitHub, VS Code, IntelliJ, Postman, MySQL Workbench & Xcode 10
Methodologies: MVC, OOP, CRUD Operations, RESTful Architecture, Agile
Database: MongoDB, MySQL, SQLite, Kusto, Sequelize

Contact: pierrepnguyen@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Berkeley Heights, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
Merchant Lifecycle Team
- Proficiently document system flow, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Quality Assurance (QA) test artifacts to ensure comprehensive project documentation.
- Develop automation tests using the Karate AI framework, contributing to the creation of a robust and reliable test suite.
- Execute thorough Quality Assurance testing on software features, ensuring the delivery of high-quality products.
- Contribute to hardware development processes, leveraging technical expertise to enhance and optimize hardware components. Implement OpenAPI specifications to streamline communication and interoperability within the system.
- Conduct detailed bug analysis, identifying root causes and providing insights for efficient issue resolution.
- Demonstrate proficiency in PagerDuty and on-call responsibilities, ensuring prompt response and resolution to critical incidents.
positions.insights: Attention to Detail, Spring Boot and +5 skills

- Develop a central repository that captures and displays KPIs in our systems by leveraging tools such as Power BI, Kusto, and Azure ML, to improve overall Service Health in SAP OTC/Professional Services area.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Completed a 14-week intensive course to gain experience in web fundamentals and full stack development. I have experience with the following frameworks and languages: 
     -Web Fundamentals (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript) 
     -Python (flask with MySQL; Django with SQLite) 
     -C# (.Net Core with MySQL; Dapper and Entity; Xamarin) 
-MEAN (JavaScript; Node; Express; Angular; MongoDB/Mongoose)
• Completed over 1200 hours on the implementation and iteration of various web projects 
• Completed building and deploying fully functioning applications in less than 5 hours
